events.finding: Teachers-union organization was attempted before 4.19 but blocked under the Rhee government; a reported April 1959 Justice Ministry interpretation is a primary-document target.
About 300 teachers/professors formed the national federation and elected a named leadership slate.

Education, Health/Social Affairs, Justice, union and broader labor actors occupied distinguishable positions; public statements, legal-interpretation request, dissolution demand, rebuttal and complaint are separate actions.
National convention elected Jo Il-mun, Kang Gi-cheol, Gye Hun-je, Kim Jong-gil and Kim Hui-jo; 83 unions and 19,883 members are reported by AKS.
Union sources characterized a mass personnel transfer affecting 397/roughly 400 teachers as anti-union retaliation; government-side order, criteria and approval chain remain to be recovered.
Secondary syntheses report suit/injunction proceedings and a Daegu High Court suspension for 25 union officers; original court docket/order is required before treating details as final.
Teachers-union representatives protested proposed statutory exclusion; 1960-09-29 National Assembly sit-in is independently archived.
A contemporaneous report says ICFTU sent support asserting teachers' organizing rights under Korean and international law; original ICFTU letter remains target.
KDF chronology records arrests during Daegu anti-two-evil-laws mobilization and names Gyeongbuk teachers-union chair Kim Mun-sim.
AKS reports about 1,500 arrests, nine indictments and life sentence for Kim Mun-sim; original arrest, indictment and revolutionary-trial records are required.

adversarial_checks: Do not call the 1960 dispute solely an Lee Byeong-do event; ministries, local government, courts and union actors differed.
Do not treat the union's description of the Gyeongbuk transfers as proof of retaliatory motive without the government's order and criteria.
Do not treat Jo Jun-yeong's governorship as proof he personally selected each transferred teacher; recover approval chain.
Do not infer Justice Ministry's June 1960 conclusion from the request alone; recover reply.
Do not conflate the reported 1959 Justice interpretation with the June 1960 interpretation request.
Do not conflate May 22 federation formation, July 17 convention/reorganization, and later naming changes.
Do not infer prosecution/conviction from the June 29 complaint against Education authorities.
Do not treat the reported Daegu High Court injunction as final merits judgment; recover docket and disposition.
Do not infer national-government direction for Gyeongbuk personnel action without cabinet/ministry records.
Do not merge post-5.16 military suppression with pre-coup civilian-government legality disputes.
Do not merge same-name Jo Jun-yeong or Lee Jong-seok identities across generations.
Do not treat later activist biographies as substitutes for contemporaneous union-office records.
